assertions: Connects to the v3 streaming endpoint (streaming.assemblyai.com/v3/ws), not the v2 realtime URL
Sets the streaming model explicitly to universal-3-6-pro (universal-3-5-pro also acceptable); not u3-rt-pro or an older model
Enables redact_pii, with policies that cover person names, phone numbers and SSNs (or the default, which is all)
Sends audio at real-time pace in small chunks
Sends Terminate and waits for Termination before exiting
Does not use word_boost, boost_param or v2-era parameters such as end_utterance_silence_threshold
Authenticates with the raw API key or a temporary token, not a Bearer prefix

expectations.text: 1. Connects to the v3 streaming endpoint (streaming.assemblyai.com/v3/ws), not the v2 realtime URL
expectations.evidence: transcribe.py:18: ENDPOINT = "wss://streaming.assemblyai.com/v3/ws"; used by connect at line 134.

expectations.text: 2. Sets the streaming model explicitly to universal-3-6-pro (universal-3-5-pro also acceptable); not u3-rt-pro or an older model
expectations.evidence: transcribe.py:17 sets MODEL = "universal-3-6-pro"; line 37 passes it as speech_model.

expectations.text: 5. Enables redact_pii, with policies that cover person names, phone numbers and SSNs (or the default, which is all)
expectations.evidence: transcribe.py:43–44 enables redact_pii and supplies policies; line 22 includes person_name, phone_number, and us_social_security_number.

expectations.text: 6. Sends audio at real-time pace in small chunks
expectations.evidence: transcribe.py:108 uses 50 ms chunks; lines 117–119 wait for each chunk's audio duration before sending.

expectations.text: 7. Sends Terminate and waits for Termination before exiting
expectations.evidence: transcribe.py:121 sends Terminate; lines 124–129 receive through Termination; line 150 awaits the receiver.

expectations.text: 8. Does not use word_boost, boost_param or v2-era parameters such as end_utterance_silence_threshold
expectations.evidence: transcribe.py:35–49 defines the connection parameters without word_boost, boost_param, or end_utterance_silence_threshold.

expectations.text: 9. Authenticates with the raw API key or a temporary token, not a Bearer prefix
expectations.evidence: transcribe.py:135: additional_headers={"Authorization": api_key}; line 180 reads the key directly from ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY.
